name: Garden Kingdom of Dessau-Wörlitz
description: Stretching between Dessau and Wörlitz in Saxony-Anhalt, this vast landscape of English-style parks, palaces and farmland covers about 142 square kilometres along the Elbe. Duke Leopold III created it in the late 18th century, making it one of continental Europe's first and largest English gardens. Visitors can wander through park scenery where even the working countryside was shaped to be beautiful.
